texts.preamble: Shantilal S/O Raymal Jain vs The State Of Maharashtra, Through ... on 21 December, 2020 Author: Amit B. Borkar Bench: Z. A. Haq, Amit B. Borkar 1 cr-apl-4 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench : Nagpur Criminal Application (Apl) No. 489 Of 2014 Shantilal S/o. Raymal Jain, Aged about 58 years, Occ. Business, R/o. Juna Babulkheda, Satguruwadi, Nagpur. . . . Applic ...V E R S U S.. State of Maharashtra through Police Station Officer, Ajni, Dist. Nagpur. .. Non - Applicant --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- None for the applicant. Shri T. A. Mirza, A.P.P. for non-applicants/State. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Coram :- Z. A. Haq And Amit B. Borkar, Jj. Dated :- 21.12.2020 Judgment
texts.facts: In this application, the applicant has prayed that the First Information Reports registered for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short "the Act of 2006") be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. The main thrust of challenge is that the allegation in the FIR does not spell out offence under the provisions of the Act of 2006 and Rules framed under it and consequently offence 2 cr-apl-489-14j.odt under section of the IPC is not made out. By order dated 31.10.2014, the present application along with connected matters was admitted and interim order granted earlier was confirmed. 3. The non-applicant no. 1 has filed reply and submitted that registration of the FIR under Section 328 of the IPC cannot be faulted, as the material on record fulfills ingredients of Section 328 of the IPC.
texts.arguments: Shri T. A. Mirza, learned A.P.P. invited our attention to the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Maharashtra Vs. Sayyed Hassan Sayyed Subhan and ors. [2018 AIR (SC) 5348] and submitted that it is open for the Food Safety Officer to independently filed complaint before the Competent Court for the offence under provision of the Act of 2006. The learned A.P.P. further submitted that the investigation in all the matters is completed and charge-sheets are ready. He also invited attention of this Court to the order passed by the Division Bench of this Court in LD-VC-CRI-APPLICATION (APPA) No. 452/2020 in the case of Ritesh Rajkumar Toshniwal Vs. State of Maharashtra (one of us Justice Z. A. Haq is a party) and submitted that 3 cr-apl-489-14j.odt similar order to be passed in the present applications as as facts of present of application are similar. 4.
